svg.title: Path-length difference from two slits
svg.desc: Two slits S1 and S2 a distance d apart send rays ℓ1 and ℓ2 at the same angle θ to a distant point on a screen. Dropping a perpendicular from S1 to the lower ray marks off the extra distance the lower ray travels, Δℓ = d sin θ. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Double-slit brightness follows the two path lengths
Probe scans a screen 1 m away
Coherent equal-amplitude slits: d = 0.20 mm, λ = 550 nm. Exact path difference sets Δφ = 2πΔℓ/λ and
I/I max = cos²(Δφ/2). Diagram spacing is exaggerated.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
